name: signpost-1.20.1-2.02.0
changelog:
**Version 2.02.0:**

- Added a config option to disable teleportation across dimensions - by [kiosion](https://github.com/kiosion)
- Added ru_ru translation - by [lineisover](https://github.com/lineisover)
- Leashed mobs and vehicles (e.g. horses) now come with you when you teleport - can be disabled in the server config
- Added bamboo signpost variants (>= 1.19)
- Added cherry signpost variants (>= 1.20)
- Tinted textures (e.g. water, grass) now properly work when painting a signpost
- Hopefully improved village generation performance

Please backup your maps, report any bugs and have fun :D
